Name: Radioactive Ore Renamed - Mana (ContentPatcher)
Author: StatisticalAnomaly
Description:
Renames radioactive ore and related items to something to do with mana and adds a few references to mana in some dialogue/cutscenes. All changes shown in added images. CJB Cheats Menu and CJB Item Spawner used for testing only. This is my first mod and i have no coding knowledge and the only reason this thing works is Pathoschild's fantastic Content Patcher documentation. Makes no changes to items from any other mod that reference radioactivity and at present I have no idea how to do that anyway.

I've little experience with other languages, so as long ive been credited there's open permissions to translate! Just let me know when you've finished so I can link to them from here!

Downloads.Description: Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, and Content Patcher 2.0+ (Small update to fix update detection)
